name: DefaultDocParser::parse
logic_name: Ingest Format Dispatch And Honest Unsupported Results

test_list.description: UTF-8 text becomes ordered paragraph blocks with source line markers.
CommonMark structures are represented as SDK blocks without losing text.
HTML DOM parsing yields readable text and ignores script/style payloads.
Quoted fields and embedded newlines are parsed as cells.
TSV extension selects tab separation instead of silently parsing as comma CSV.
Recognized PDF magic bytes take precedence over a misleading plain-text payload extension.
Unrecognized input does not get guessed from a misleading extension.
Input over the configured byte cap returns TooLarge before parsing.

inputs.name: src
inputs.description: Untrusted bytes, file name, and optional MIME.

output_description: Bounded normalized document or a typed unsupported/malformed/size error.
